Jordan plays video games for 2 hours every day. In one week (7 days), that amounts to 2 hours/day × 7 days = 14 hours. If he spent that time working at his part-time job, which pays $10 per hour, he would earn 14 hours × $10/hour = $140.

The note about a similar problem and doubling likely refers to versions where the problem also states how many hours Jordan already works, leading some to mistakenly add the video game time to his existing work hours and double his total income. However, this problem does not specify his current work schedule—it only asks how much he would earn from converting his video game time into work time. Therefore, the correct amount is simply the value of those 14 hours.

Answer: $140
